ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of approximately 7:3 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centrally located low-intensity (black) contiguous geometric region extending from the median notch, flanked by high-intensity (white) lateral lobes. Transition zones show high-frequency mottling and pixel stippling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped central notch with an approximate internal pixel angle of 50 degrees and significant bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary with high-frequency, low-amplitude (2-5 pixel) variations along the entirety of the trailing edge lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve fitted to the posterior boundary of both fluke lobes, tapering to rounded distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, localized dark-intensity pixel clusters (focal spots) distributed across the white field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: High-contrast white pixel formation resembling alphanumeric characters 'OC' or 'QC' located on the left-medial low-intensity (black) region.
other_distinctive_markers: Single, isolated low-intensity (dark) focal point situated in the central-posterior region of the right lobe's white high-intensity field.
